title: Real Research Today: Cryonics 2.0 Facilities
definition: Today's documented research behind Cryonics 2.0 Facilities.
description:
The road to Cryonics 2.0 Facilities is already being paved. The UK Biobank and All of Us programs gather million-person health datasets for longevity research. The WHO's ICD-11 added an extension code for aging-related conditions, legitimizing the field.

The Longevity Science Foundation and XPRIZE Healthspan ($101M prize) push measurable rejuvenation. Together these programs form the vitrification labs foundation that Cryonics 2.0 Facilities will build on — the facility logistics results, the standby teams methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as facility logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Cryonics 2.0 Facilities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Cryonics 2.0 Facilities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Cryonics 2.0 Facilities — next-generation low-temperature preservation.

Phase 1 — Prove (vitrification labs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (facility logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (standby teams): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (revival research): facility hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and biostasis-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
